definitions.explanation: The board used to play the game of go ({囲碁|いご}), marked with a grid of lines on which stones are placed at the intersections.

examples.japanese: {囲碁盤|いごばん}の{上|うえ}に{石|いし}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: Arrange the stones on the go board.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{木|き}でできた{立派|りっぱ}な{囲碁盤|いごばん}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: My grandfather has a splendid go board made of wood.

notes:
Also called simply {碁盤|ごばん}. The standard board has a 19-by-19 grid of intersecting lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {囲碁盤|いごばん}を{囲|かこ}む: to sit around a go board
- {囲碁盤|いごばん}の{目|め}: the grid intersections of a go board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {碁盤|ごばん}: go board — the shorter, more common word; {碁盤|ごばん}{目|め} also means a grid pattern
- {将棋盤|しょうぎばん}: shogi board — for Japanese chess
